rules.name: Generic secret assignment (broad keyword, deep profile only)

provenance.source: gitleaks/betterleaks generic-api-key rule (github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks, github.com/betterleaks/betterleaks config/*.toml): both require one of a broad keyword set (access, auth, api, credential, creds, key, password, secret, token) followed within ~20 characters by an assignment operator -- confirmed neither rule is actually keyword-free despite sometimes being described that way

nomatch: keyboard shortcuts are useful for this workflow
